_comment: USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Rates hand-verified 2026-07-17 from screenshots of each vendor's OWN pricing page (not aggregators). Standard/short-context, non-cached, non-batch tier in every case — the tier our calls actually use. Batch APIs offer ~50% off at every vendor: relevant option for the scale-up run.

gpt-5.6-sol.note: long-context tier is $10/$45 — irrelevant at our sizes

gemini-3.5-flash.note: output price INCLUDES thinking tokens — which is why api_describers counts thoughts_token_count

gemini-3.1-pro-preview.note: output includes thinking tokens; >200k-prompt tier is $4/$18 — irrelevant at our sizes

claude-sonnet-5.note: INTRO pricing through 2026-08-31; becomes $3/$15 on Sep 1 (+50%) — re-run recompute_costs.py with updated rates for any post-August budgeting

qwen3.7-plus.source: alibabacloud.com Model Studio pricing, Singapore/International, <=256K tier
qwen3.7-plus.note: LIST price used for budgeting; limited-time 20% promo means actual bills run ~$0.32/$1.28 until it ends — dashboards will read ~20% under computed. Thinking-mode output same $1.60

claude-haiku-4-5-20251001.note: not in the comparison; fill if ever used

gemini-3.6-flash.note: GA 2026-07; press/OpenRouter report $1.50/$7.50 (output CHEAPER than 3.5 Flash's $9) — hand-verify against the Google pricing page before recompute, per policy. Output presumably includes thinking tokens like the rest of the family.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite.source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing — paid tier, fetched from the official Google docs page 2026-07-27
gemini-3.5-flash-lite.note: VERIFIED against the vendor page (previously null/press-reported). Batch API = 50% discount per the same page: input $0.15, output $1.25 per 1M. Gemini bills thinking tokens as OUTPUT — api_describers counts candidates + thoughts, so output_tokens already includes them.
